name: Hudson River Estuary Grants: Local Stewardship Planning

funder.name: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation

summary: Hudson River Estuary grants for local stewardship planning, climate adaptation, habitat conservation planning and tributary watershed stewardship in the estuary watershed.
reporting: Quarterly progress and financial reports are required for Hudson River Estuary Program grants.

status.quote: Grant funding is currently available for municipalities and non-profit organizations within the Hudson River Estuary Program boundaries

deadline.quote: Applications are due in the State Financial System (SFS) at 3 p.m. on December 17, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include Governmental Entities, Municipalities, and Quasi-Governmental Entities, including but not limited to Counties, Cities, Towns, Villages, or Indian nation or tribe

geography.quote: Grant funding is currently available for municipalities and non-profit organizations within the Hudson River Estuary Program boundaries

access.quote: Applications are due in the State Financial System (SFS) at 3 p.m. on December 17, 2026.

window.quote: Four Requests for Applications (RFAs) are available: Tributary Restoration and Resilience, Local Stewardship Planning, River Education, and River Access.

amount.quote: The minimum grant award for Local Stewardship Planning is $10,500 and the maximum is $50,000.

pool.quote: $350,000 for Local Stewardship Planning Approximately $350,000 is available

reporting.quote: Reporting is required on a quarterly basis for all Hudson River Estuary Program grants.
